department: Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology

deadline.value: December 1 for fall 2027 entry, domestic and international.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for both domestic and international students is December 1 for admission the following Fall.

fee_waiver.value: Limited need-based waivers; request by email by November 15.
fee_waiver.quote: The department offers limited application fee waivers and they must be requested by November 15 at 5pm Tucson local time

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to correspond directly with faculty in our Department whose work is of particular interest.

funding.value: The department makes every effort to fund PhD students for up to ten semesters, mainly via teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: The Department makes every effort to support doctoral students who make acceptable progress in their first ten semesters of study

entry_route.value: A biology-related bachelor's is recommended; MS holders are also encouraged.
entry_route.quote: We recommend that applicants have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a biology-related field. Students who have a M.S. degree in a related field are encouraged to apply.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: Molecular and Cellular Biology and other life-science PhDs are separate programs, not covered.
